stemMd: Asked why the policy was wise, the official replied that it was the kind of policy wise governments adopt, offering a ______ justification.
explanationMd: The reply assumes the wisdom it is meant to establish, merely restating it through wise governments. That is circular justification rather than independent evidence.

distractorRationale.c: The reply contains no numerical analysis.
distractorRationale.b: No observations or data are supplied.
distractorRationale.d: No actual governments or outcomes are compared.
distractorRationale.e: The reply concedes no opposing point.
